system.notes:
When night falls, demonic wolf spirits stalk through corn and wheat fields. Farmers who get lost in the fields past dusk are doomed to be hunted and devoured! On occasion, a ravenous roggenwulf will creep from the cornfields to snatch sleeping children from their beds. Only a silver horseshoe hung over a door or window can prevent the beasts from crossing through. A slavering wolf demon with peeled-back skin on its face that exposes white bone. Its burning eyes bob like witchlights in the darkness of the cornfields.

AC 13, HP 32, ATK 3 bite +5 (1d8) or 1 howl, MV double near, S +3, D +1, C +1, I +0, W +1, Ch +0, AL C, LV 7

Impervious. Only damaged by silver or magical sources.

Howl. All who hear it DC 12 CHA or cannot act on their next turn.

Silver Aversion. Takes double damage from silvered weapons. Cannot cross a threshold that has a silver object hung over it.

Art by Yuri Perkowski-Domingos, 2023
